faq.title: FAQ
faq.sub: What leadership teams, managers and HR ask us most.

items.q: Does it work for every role in the company?
items.a: Yes. Eleva evaluates all your people, from senior management and managers to the operations, sales and administration teams. Each with a form specific to its job.

The form is always a proposal, never an imposition: you review the questions, adjust what you need and approve it before launching the process. Each process keeps its configuration, so past results stay intact.

items.q: Do you also measure workplace climate?
items.a: Yes. The climate survey is anonymous: answers are stored without a name and results are shown only for groups of a minimum size the company sets. The report shows each dimension, each unit and how they changed since earlier measurements.

items.q: How does it align with labour regulations?
items.a: The form of each job shows which rules it is aligned with: labour law, workplace and sexual harassment, equal pay, non-discrimination, occupational health and safety and personal data protection.

items.q: Which perspectives and stages does the 360° have?
items.a: A 360° evaluation looks at each person from four views: their own, their manager's, their team's and their peers'. The company decides which take part and how much each one counts, and can start with the manager's view and the self-evaluation only. The process goes through six stages: in preparation, started, in feedback, feedback answered, finished and closed.

items.q: Does it work for a group with several companies?
items.a: Yes. The group sees the progress and the results of all its companies, and each company runs its own process.
